llm_review.summary: This Terraform plan builds an isolated AWS data ingestion pipeline. It provisions a VPC, public subnets, an internet gateway and route tables, IAM roles, an EC2 producer instance, an S3 event bucket, an SQS queue, and a ClickHouse service backed by PostgreSQL.

description.constant_value: Producer and ClickHouse client, egress only

command.constant_value:
set -euo pipefail
url="https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1/organizations/$CLICKHOUSE_ORG_ID/services/$SERVICE_ID/clickpipes/$PIPE_ID"
for _ in $(seq 60); do
  state=$(curl -sS --fail --user "$CLICKHOUSE_CLOUD_API_KEY:$CLICKHOUSE_CLOUD_API_SECRET" "$url" |
    python3 -c 'import json, sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["result"]["state"])')
  echo "pipe $PIPE_ID: $state"
  case "$state" in
    Running) exit 0 ;;
    Failed | InternalError) exit 1 ;;
  esac
  sleep 15
done
echo "pipe not Running after 15 min" >&2
exit 1

psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "
  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.orders (
    id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    customer_id integer NOT NULL,
    status      text NOT NULL,
    amount      numeric(10,2) NOT NULL
  )"
